title: master~
description: `master~` provides a master fader and DSP control for Pd, with support for an eight-channel SonoBus VST plugin in parallel with the main output. Audio can be connected directly to its inlets or collected from `stereo~`, `quad~`, and `oct~` channels using `catchall~`; if SonoBus’s separate thread causes performance problems, remove `-p` from both indicated `open` messages inside `master~`.
